LendingPool.deposit: accepts user liquidity, mints aTokens and forwards funds to the core.
LendingPool.borrow: validates collateral, fees and rate mode before state update and transfer.
LendingPool.repay: settles borrow balances, fees and routes funds back to the reserve.
LendingPool.redeemUnderlying: only callable by the overlying aToken, sends underlying to the user.
LendingPool.flashLoan: sends liquidity to a receiver contract and requires fee repayment.
LendingPool.liquidationCall: delegatecalls the liquidation manager with caller supplied parameters.
LendingPoolCore.transferToUser: ERC20 safeTransfer or raw ETH call to the user address.
LendingPoolCore.transferToReserve: pulls ERC20 via safeTransferFrom or handles msg.value and refunds excess ETH.
LendingPoolCore.transferToFeeCollectionAddress: forwards origination fees to the token distributor.
ERC20 internal transfer implementation that mutates balances and emits Transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom: moves tokens and decreases the caller allowance.
ERC20.approve: sets an allowance for a spender.
AToken.redeem: cumulates user balance, burns aTokens and calls pool.redeemUnderlying.
AToken.mintOnDeposit: onlyLendingPool mint hook invoked on user deposits.
AToken internal: mints accrued interest and updates the user index.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the depositor and the aToken mint recipient in deposit.
msg.sender borrows and is resolved as the borrower in borrow.
msg.sender is the repayer and may be compared with _onBehalfOf in repay.
onlyOverlyingAToken compares msg.sender with the reserve aToken address.
flashLoan is reachable by any caller for any receiver address.
The liquidator identity is msg.sender and its parameters drive the delegatecall.
onlyLendingPool requires lendingPoolAddress == msg.sender before transferring to a user.
onlyLendingPool validates msg.sender before pulling funds into the reserve.
ERC20 transfer passes msg.sender as the sender to _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decreases the msg.sender allowance.
approve writes the allowance of msg.sender over the spender.
isOwner compares msg.sender with the stored _owner address.
ifAdmin checks msg.sender against the stored admin slot.
onlyOwner restricts transferOwnership to the current owner.
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership to the current owner.
Interest accrual is derived from block.timestamp, a miner influenced value.
lastUpdateTimestamp is written from block.timestamp during borrow state update.
Compounded borrow balance depends on block.timestamp based interest.
The Deposit event timestamp is taken directly from block.timestamp.
flashLoan calls receiver.executeOperation before verifying the returned liquidity.
The untrusted receiver regains control and can re-enter the lending pool during the flash loan.
liquidationCall delegatecalls the liquidation manager supplied by the addresses provider.
Liquidity transfers to users use a raw ETH call with a fixed gas stipend.
Excess ETH refunds to the user are performed with a low-level call.
callOptionalReturn executes an untyped low-level call to the token contract.
upgradeToAndCall delegatecalls initialization data on the new implementation.
The upgrade path ends in _setImplementation storing the new logic address.
upgradeToAndCall is guarded by the ifAdmin check.
changeAdmin is guarded by the ifAdmin check.
deposit forwards user funds to the core through transferToReserve.
deposit mints the matching aToken amount through mintOnDeposit.
redeemUnderlying pays the underlying asset out through core.transferToUser.
repay routes origination fees to the fee collection address.
repay returns the principal portion of the repayment to the reserve.
borrow triggers core.updateStateOnBorrow to persist the new debt.
AToken.redeem invokes pool.redeemUnderlying after burning aTokens.
redeem cumulates the user balance before computing the redeemable amount.
mintOnDeposit cumulates accrued interest before minting new aTokens.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to the internal _transfer.
getCompoundedBorrowBalance relies on the interest calculation helpers.
updateRedirectedBalanceOfRedirectionAddressInternal compounds the target address first.
transferOwnership only executes when the onlyOwner modifier passes.
renounceOwnership only executes when the onlyOwner modifier passes.
ERC20 _transfer mutates the sender and recipient balance entries.
transferFrom decreases the spender allowance stored in _allowances.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
Redirection bookkeeping updates redirectedBalances for the target address.
cumulateBalanceInternal refreshes the stored user index.
cumulateBalanceInternal mints the interest increase into _balances.
updateStateOnBorrow writes the reserve borrow totals and indexes.
getCompoundedBorrowBalance reads the user reserve accounting struct.
redeem resolves the reserve through the AToken underlying asset address.
The initializer modifier compares the revision with lastInitializedRevision.
isOwner compares msg.sender against the stored _owner value.
The nonReentrant guard increments, snapshots and re-checks _guardCounter around deposit.
onlyLendingPool compares msg.sender with the stored lendingPoolAddress.
Registry stored addresses govern which contract is authorized to trigger reserve transfers.

normalization_plan.reason: Reserve address parameter is only meaningful inside the deposit entry point flow.
Deposit amount parameter is consumed directly by the deposit state-update and token mint.
Payable user parameter is only used to route the redeemed underlying asset.
Flash loan amount parameter feeds the fee computation inside flashLoan.
Untrusted receiver parameter is the target of the executeOperation external call.
Repayment beneficiary parameter is only consumed by the repay accounting flow.
Implementation address parameter is stored and delegatecalled by the upgrade flow.
Memory struct of local borrow variables exists solely to compress borrow stack usage.
Computed fee local is used only for the flash loan fee and balance checks.
Liquidity snapshot local only validates the redeem amount in redeemUnderlying.
Allowance local is computed right before the SafeERC20 optional return call.
